# Dashboard features

<!-- GENERATED by `pnpm ui:docs` from packages/dashboard/src/ui/features.ts. Do not edit. -->

Every feature of the pxsig dashboard: what it is for, the states it handles, how it is used, its copy keys
(`src/copy/en.json`) and the UI contract components it renders. An adapter that renders these components
well renders every feature; see [build-adapter.md](build-adapter.md).

## Shell

### Top bar

`shell.top-bar` · The report's title (its label, else the project name) with the versions on hover, the section links with their counts, and the controls pinned at the end: start review, project, modes, connection, last check, theme, review status.

States:

- **loading**: The page shows a loading line until the first data arrives.
- **error**: The page shows the load error instead of the dashboard.
- **offline**: The connection badge reads Offline; the review button is hidden.
- **static**: The connection badge reads Static report; nothing that writes is shown.

Interactions:

- Open a section (a plain #<id> link; Back and Forward move between sections)
- Start a review session on the next queue with undecided entries
- Switch project (when the server holds more than one)

Components: `AppShell`, `AppMain`, `TopNav`, `NavList`, `NavLink`, `NavEnd`, `Badge`, `StatusBadge`, `Button`, `Select`, `Tooltip`

Copy: `app`, `tabs`

Files: `src/App`

### Theme toggle

`shell.theme` · Switches between the light and dark theme; the choice is remembered per viewer.

Interactions:

- Toggle light / dark

Components: `UiProvider`, `IconButton`, `Icon`

Copy: `app.theme`

Files: `src/App`, `src/main`

### Coverage banner

`shell.coverage-banner` · Shown on every section while the coverage ledger has errors, or entries wait for a first approval: the headline, setup problems, a link to Coverage and the safe repair. On the Overview the errors card carries the errors instead, so they are not shown twice.

States:

- **static**: No repair button: a static report cannot write.

Interactions:

- View the components with problems
- Run the safe repair (never approves, never writes a signature)

Components: `Alert`, `AlertTitle`, `AlertDescription`, `Button`

Copy: `coverage.banner`, `coverage.headline`

Files: `src/views/Integrity`

## Overview

### Latest check in numbers

`overview.counts` · Checked, passed, changed, flaky, new accessibility violations and duration of the last check; the changed, flaky and accessibility figures open what they count.

States:

- **empty**: Without a check: the command that runs one.

Interactions:

- Open a review session, or the filtered list (static)

Components: `StatGroup`

### Open Items

`overview.open-items` · What needs a decision, one row per kind (changed, new, rejected, render errors, coverage errors, accessibility, flaky), each with its action.

States:

- **empty**: A line saying nothing is open; the rows stay, at zero.

Interactions:

- Start a review, or view the entries, from a row

Components: `Card`, `CardHeader`, `CardTitle`, `CardContent`, `DataTable`, `Button`

Copy: `overview`

Files: `src/views/Overview`

### Overview columns

`overview.layout` · Below the counts, two equal columns: open items, then stale entries by component, on the left; errors (only while there are any), then changed entries per run, on the right. One column, left then right, when the page is narrow.

Components: `Card`

Copy: `overview`

Files: `src/views/Overview`

### Errors

`overview.errors` · The coverage banner's details and the safe repair first (only while there is something to repair or approve), then the render errors of the last check and coverage errors (components, setup), one row each, opening the render errors list or Coverage on that component. Shown only while there are errors.

States:

- **static**: No repair button: a static report cannot write.

Interactions:

- Open the render errors, or Coverage on a component, from a row
- Run the safe repair

Components: `Card`, `CardHeader`, `CardTitle`, `CardDescription`, `CardContent`, `DataTable`, `Button`

`overview.changed-runs` · The Runs chart of changed entries per recorded run, as a line, in the right column.

### Stale Entries by Component

`overview.stale` · A heatmap of the components with stale verdicts: one tile per component, coloured by its share of stale entries in five steps, with the count on the tile, highest share first. The Overview shows the first 12, Coverage all of them.

States:

- **empty**: No stale entries: a line saying so.

Interactions:

- Open Coverage on a component from its tile
- View all on Coverage

## Coverage

### Coverage ledger

`coverage.ledger` · Whether every story is registered, rendered, checked and current, per component, with counts that filter the table, stale entries by component as a heatmap, and the entries of a chosen component.

States:

- **empty**: Without integrity data: the commands that produce it.

Interactions:

- Filter by an issue count
- Show components with issues, or all
- Open a component from the table or a heatmap tile (a tile filters the table to it), then an entry in the inspector

## Inspector

### Inspector header

`inspector.header` · The entry id, its context and reasons, its verdict, its other modes and states, the position in the list, the review buttons and Close.

States:

Interactions:

- Previous or next entry (← → (J / K))
- Switch mode or state of the same story
- Close (Esc)

### Image stage

`inspector.stage` · Baseline and latest render side by side, as a swipe, onion skin, pixel difference or signature cells; pan, zoom, change regions and detail tiles; built on the diff-viewer primitives.

States:

- **loading**: A loading line until both images decode.
- **error**: Which image is missing.

Interactions:

- Choose the view (1–5)
- Fit, actual size, zoom (F, 0, + −)
- Next or previous change (N / ⇧N)
- Drag to pan, wheel to zoom, drag the swipe handle (or arrow keys on it)
- Tolerance, swipe, opacity and cell sliders; highlight, regions and tiles switches

## Storybook panel

### Storybook panel

`embed.panel` · The inspector for one story inside the Storybook addon panel, without the page chrome; details open on demand.

States:

- **empty**: A line when the story has no checked entry.

Interactions:

- The inspector keys, on the focused panel
- Show or hide details

Components: `Switch`, `IconButton`, `SegmentedChoice`

Copy: `app.embedEmpty`, `inspector.toggles.details`

Files: `src/App`, `src/inspector/Inspector`, `src/inspector/controls`, `src/inspector/side/ViewSection`

### Decision window

`embed.decide` · The small window the Storybook panel's Approve, Reject and Accept go through: the panel is a frame on another site, where the dashboard link is not sent, so the window (this server's own page) takes the decision from the panel, posts it and closes. Without the dashboard link it stays open and says to open the link first; a tab without it shows the same instruction under the inspector's header.

States:

- **error**: The decision was not recorded: the reason, or the instruction to open the dashboard link first.
- **empty**: Opened on its own (no panel behind it): a line saying it has nothing to do.

Interactions:

- Approve, reject or accept in the Storybook panel opens it; it closes once the decision is recorded
